description: 4-Layer RCA Dashboard: Executive HUD + Machine Telemetry + Production Context + Alarm Stream. Schema-driven naming. Shared crosshair. Fixed axis scaling.

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT eqp_id AS __text, eqp_id AS __value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) ORDER BY eqp_id

panels.title: Estimated Yield (%)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
  WHERE GREATEST(ABS(pe_1),ABS(pe_2),ABS(pe_3),ABS(pe_4),ABS(pe_5),ABS(pe_6)) <= pe_setting
) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pe_1 IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS value
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE $__timeFilter("time")
  AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
  AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring});

panels.description: Estimated Yield: percentage of samples where max|PE| <= pe_setting (within tolerance).

panels.title: Fleet Availability (%)

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (eqp_id) eqp_id, state
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE $__timeFilter("time")
    AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY eqp_id, "time" DESC
)
SELECT ROUND((100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = true) / NULLIF(COUNT(*))::NUMERIC, 0), 1) AS value FROM latest;

panels.description: Percent of selected machines whose latest state in the selected time range is true.

panels.title: Avg Cpk (Fleet)

targets.rawSql:
WITH pe_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id, d.pe_setting, p.pe
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.pe_1),(d.pe_2),(d.pe_3),(d.pe_4),(d.pe_5),(d.pe_6)) p(pe)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time")
    AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND p.pe IS NOT NULL AND d.pe_setting IS NOT NULL
), stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, AVG(pe) AS mean_pe, STDDEV_SAMP(pe) AS sigma, AVG(pe_setting) AS lim
  FROM pe_samples GROUP BY eqp_id
), cpk AS (
  SELECT LEAST((lim - mean_pe) / NULLIF(3*sigma,0), (mean_pe + lim) / NULLIF(3*sigma,0)) AS value FROM stats
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(value)::NUMERIC, 2) AS value FROM cpk;

panels.description: Average real Cpk across machines with PE data in the selected filters. Assumes symmetric +/- pe_setting limits.

panels.title: Running

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (eqp_id) eqp_id, state
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY eqp_id, "time" DESC
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = true)::NUMERIC AS value FROM latest;

panels.description: Count of machines with state=true (powered on and available). Red < 8, Green >= 8 of 10.

panels.title: PE Limit Used

targets.rawSql:
WITH pe_rows AS (
  SELECT
    GREATEST(
      ABS(pe_1), ABS(pe_2), ABS(pe_3),
      ABS(pe_4), ABS(pe_5), ABS(pe_6)
    ) AS max_error,
    pe_setting
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
    AND pe_1 IS NOT NULL
    AND pe_setting > 0
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(100.0 * max_error / pe_setting)::NUMERIC, 1) AS value
FROM pe_rows

panels.description: Average MAX|PE| divided by the PE limit stored on each record. This normalized scale allows machines with different PE limits to be compared fairly.

panels.title: Avg Temperature

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(temperature)::NUMERIC, 1) AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND temperature IS NOT NULL

panels.description: Fleet-wide average temperature. Target 22±2°C. Red outside 20-24°C, Amber 20-24°C, Green 22-24°C.

panels.title: Avg Humidity

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(humidity)::NUMERIC, 1) AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND humidity IS NOT NULL

panels.description: Fleet-wide average humidity. Target 55±5%RH. Red outside 50-60%, Amber 50-60%, Green 55-60%.

panels.title: Critical Alarms

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*)::NUMERIC AS value
FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON a.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_code::TEXT
WHERE a.equipmentid IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND m.alarm_type ILIKE '%Critical%';

panels.description: Counts real alarm rows for selected machine IDs that match a Critical master code. Zero is valid because current log codes do not match the supplied master.

panels.title: Production & Process Table

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (eqp_id) eqp_id AS "Machine", mo AS "Job (MO)", fpn AS "Part (FPN)", layer_name AS "Layer", (board_no::TEXT || '/' || total_board::TEXT) AS "Progress", ROUND(temperature::NUMERIC, 1) AS "temperature (°C)", ROUND(humidity::NUMERIC, 1) AS "humidity (%RH)", ROUND(scan_speed::NUMERIC, 1) AS "scan_speed (mm/s)", ROUND(thickness::NUMERIC, 3) AS "thickness (mm)", ROUND(resist_dosage::NUMERIC, 1) AS "resist_dosage", state AS "state" FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY eqp_id, time DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Latest production context per machine: job info + live physical parameters (temperature, humidity, scan_speed, thickness, resist_dosage, state).

panels.title: temperature Compliance (22±2°C)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, eqp_id AS metric, CASE WHEN temperature BETWEEN 20 AND 24 THEN 2 WHEN temperature BETWEEN 19 AND 25 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND temperature IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time ASC

panels.description: 3-color compliance matrix per machine. Green 20-24°C, Amber 19-25°C, Red outside.

panels.title: humidity Compliance (55±5%)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, eqp_id AS metric, CASE WHEN humidity BETWEEN 50 AND 60 THEN 2 WHEN humidity BETWEEN 45 AND 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND humidity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time ASC

panels.description: 3-color compliance matrix per machine. Green 50-60%, Amber 45-65%, Red outside.

panels.title: Scan Speed & Air Vacuum

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, eqp_id || ' - scan_speed' AS metric, AVG(scan_speed) AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND scan_speed IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, eqp_id || ' - air_vacuum' AS metric, AVG(air_vacuum) AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND air_vacuum IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Dual Y-axis: scan_speed (left, mm/s) and air_vacuum (right, kPa) per machine.

panels.title: Thickness & Resist Dosage

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, eqp_id || ' - thickness' AS metric, AVG(thickness) AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND thickness IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, eqp_id || ' - resist_dosage' AS metric, AVG(resist_dosage) AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND resist_dosage IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Dual Y-axis: thickness (left, mm) and resist_dosage (right, mJ/cm²) per machine.

panels.title: Scale X / Y

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, eqp_id || ' - scale_x' AS metric, AVG(scale_x) AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND scale_x IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, eqp_id || ' - scale_y' AS metric, AVG(scale_y) AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND scale_y IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: XY calibration drift. High-precision (6 decimals) monitoring of scale_x and scale_y ratios. Drift from 1.0 indicates lens magnification error.

panels.title: Calculated Time per Board

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', "time", TIMESTAMPTZ '2000-01-01') AS "time", eqp_id AS metric,
       ROUND((AVG(total_time / NULLIF(total_board)::NUMERIC,0))::NUMERIC,2) AS value
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND total_board > 0
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.description: Calculated value from total_time divided by total_board. Confirm the source definition of total_time before treating this as authoritative cycle time.

panels.title: Z-Score: temperature

targets.rawSql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, AVG(temperature) AS mu, STDDEV_SAMP(temperature) AS sigma
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND temperature IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY eqp_id
)
SELECT d."time", d.eqp_id AS metric, ROUND((((d.temperature-s.mu)/NULLIF(s.sigma)::NUMERIC,0))::NUMERIC,2) AS "Z-Score"
FROM public.ldi_data d JOIN stats s ON d.eqp_id=s.eqp_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time") AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
  AND d.temperature IS NOT NULL AND s.sigma > 0 ORDER BY d."time";

panels.description: 3-sigma Z-Score on temperature per machine. Green ±2 (normal), Amber 2.5 (watch), Red 3+ (anomaly).

panels.title: Latest Alarm Records (Historical)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.logdate AS "Time", a.equipmentid AS "Machine", a.errorcode AS "errorcode", a.errortime AS "errortime",
       COALESCE(m.alarm_msg,a.errorcode::TEXT) AS "Message", COALESCE(m.alarm_type,'UNMAPPED') AS "Severity"
FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON a.errorcode::TEXT=m.alarm_code::TEXT
WHERE a.equipmentid IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY a.logdate DESC LIMIT 30;

panels.description: Latest real alarm rows for selected machine IDs, independent of telemetry time because the exports cover different dates.

options.content:
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@300;400;600;800&display=swap');

@keyframes gradientBG {
    0% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
    50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
    100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
}

@keyframes edgeGlow {
    0% { border-color: rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.3); }
    50% { border-color: rgba(0, 255, 135, 0.6); box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 255, 135, 0.2), inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 255, 135, 0.05); }
    100% { border-color: rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.3); }
}

/* Global Background */
.main-view, .react-grid-layout, .dashboard-container, body {
    background: linear-gradient(-45deg, #0b0f19, #141416, #090a0f, #1a1525) !important;
    background-size: 400% 400% !important;
    animation: gradientBG 15s ease infinite !important;
}

/* Panel Backgrounds (Ultra Glassmorphism) */
.panel-container {
    background: rgba(15, 15, 20, 0.6) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
    border-radius: 16px !important;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 32px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02) !important;
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(180%);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(180%);
    transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
}

/* Hover effect */
.panel-container:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.01);
    animation: edgeGlow 3s infinite !important;
    z-index: 100;
}

/* Typography overriding */
.panel-title-text, .grafana-tooltip, text, div {
    font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif !important;
}

/* Header colors */
.panel-title-text {
    font-weight: 600 !important;
    letter-spacing: 1px !important;
    font-size: 18px !important;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    background: -webkit-linear-gradient(45deg, #00F2FE, #00FF87);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
}

/* Scrollbar hiding for clean look */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); 
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #00F2FE, #7F00FF); 
    border-radius: 10px;
}

/* Hide the injector panel itself */
div[data-panelid="9999"] { display: none !important; }
</style>
